reliability.note: MAE, RMSE, R2 and MAPE describe performance on held-out test data. They are not an individual prediction confidence percentage.

notes.geographic_scope: The current dataset provides station_id and location_type, but does not contain actual ward/zone IDs.
notes.station_load: station_load is the load/utilization measure provided by the dataset; it is not a separately predicted target.
notes.demand_trend: Trend is calculated from recent predicted demand values for the same station and time period.
